name: Colorado Trail Day 7: Turquoise Lake → Twin Lakes
description: Made friends with a gorgeous fox that hiked with me for a bit. Legs and knees are starting to really feel the downhills - first day I felt sluggish so it's the perfect time for a zero in Leadville. Caught a hitch with Jon from Norway who had just done the Bells Traverse today and Little Bear the day before that so we had plenty of things to chat about
